response.answer: Yanjun Gao is an Assistant Professor at CU Anschutz, specializing in natural language processing and AI for mental health diagnosis and treatment. She is highly regarded for her work on large language models in clinical applications. Her research focuses on improving mental health outcomes through advanced AI techniques.

results.content: Dr. Yanjun Gao is an Assistant Professor at the Department of Biomedical Informatics at the University of Colorado Anschutz Campus. Dr. Gao’s research primarily focuses on natural language processing and artificial intelligence, with a particular emphasis on their applications in health and education. * Large Language Models with Temporal Reasoning for Longitudinal Clinical Summarization and Prediction * When Raw Data Prevails: Are Large Language Model Embeddings Effective in Numerical Data Representation for Medical Machine Learning Applications? * One paper about Large Language Models for Tabular Data Embedding is accepted to EMNLP 2024 as Findings! * The LARK Lab at Department of Biomedical Informatics, CU-Anschutz has several openings! BENCH: Diagnostic Reasoning Benchmark for Clinical Natural Language Processing
